# Mold Repair Request for Austin Apartment

A polite but firm note is below, followed by a practical record-keeping checklist. I’m assuming the tenant wants to preserve a professional tone while clearly asking for timely action.

## Ready-to-Send Message

Subject: Request for Prompt Bathroom Mold Repair

Hello [Landlord/Property Manager Name],

I’m writing to report mold in the bathroom of my apartment, which I discovered on 2026-03-12. I moved in on 2026-02-01, and this appears to be a maintenance issue that needs prompt attention.

Per the lease, major repairs are the landlord’s responsibility. I previously sent an email about this issue, but I have not received a response in the past 5 days. Please let me know when this can be inspected and repaired as soon as possible.

Because mold can affect both the unit and my health, I would appreciate a written response confirming next steps and an estimated repair timeline. I’m available to coordinate access during reasonable hours.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Sincerely,
[Tenant Name]
[Unit Number]
[Phone Number]

## Documentation to Keep

- Copy of the original email and any follow-up messages
- Screenshots showing the dates and timestamps of your messages
- Photos or short videos of the mold, including wide shots and close-ups
- Notes on where the mold is located and whether it is spreading
- A dated log of any odors, leaks, humidity, or bathroom ventilation issues
- Copies of the lease section covering repairs and landlord responsibilities
- Any replies, voicemails, or texts from the landlord or manager
- Receipts for any out-of-pocket costs related to the issue
- Notes about any health symptoms or disruptions caused by the mold
- A timeline of events: move-in date, discovery date, first notice, and follow-up date

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Save Draft] https://www.usa.gov/
Action: [Button: Tenant Rights] https://www.texasattorneygeneral.gov/consumer-protection/home-real-estate-and-travel/renters-rights

## Sources

- Texas renters’ rights: https://www.texasattorneygeneral.gov/consumer-protection/home-real-estate-and-travel/renters-rights
- Austin housing resources: https://www.austintexas.gov/department/housing
- USA tenant and housing info: https://www.usa.gov/housing-renters
